title: Apple TV Deal: Here’s How to Save More Than 50% Off a Streaming Subscription

Afterward, Prime Video (as a standalone service) starts at $8.99 per month with an ad-supported plan, while Amazon Prime starts at $14.99 per month, or $139 per year. Learn more about Amazon Prime and its benefits here .

What’s Streaming on Apple TV?

Apple TV has a great selection of original movies and TV shows, including Widow’s Bay , Pluribus , Severance , Yo Gabba Gabbaland! , Your Friends and Neighbors , The Morning Show , Ted Lasso , The Studio , Long Way Up and Long Way Home , Killers of the Flower Moon , CODA , Fly Me to the Moon , Tetris and others.

In addition, the streaming service has music programming and concert series, like Watch the Sound With Mark Ronson , Soundbreaking , Behind the Music , 1971: The Year That Music Changed Everything , Jennifer Lopez’s Apple Music Live Concert , The Beatles: A Complete Anthology , Bruce Springsteen’s Letter to You and many others.

It has live sports too, with streaming access to all F1 Grand Prix races and MLS matches, as well as MLB Friday Night Baseball .

For Prime Day, you can get Apple TV as an add-on channel for Prime Video on sale for $5.99 per month (regularly $12.99 per month) for your first two months of service — a 54% savings.
